revenueModel.text: Homebuyers pay for completed homes, land and lots; renters and bulk buyers pay for rental properties; homebuilders pay Forestar for lots; and homebuyers pay mortgage origination and title fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Most of our homebuilding revenue is generated from the sale of completed homes and to a lesser extent from the sale of land and lots.
